title: MyFinder device pack loader 1
$comment: UTF-8 JSON, maximum 262144 bytes; reject duplicate object keys and non-JSON numeric constants before schema validation. Integers must be JSON integer tokens (not booleans or 1.0). Strings marked x-printable use Unicode Python str.isprintable semantics (exclude all Unicode Other/Separator categories except ASCII space). entries + disabled <= 2000. Structural errors, disallowed profile match fields and unsupported profileRev reject the whole pack. Semantic conflicts reject every affected row: duplicate VID/PID even across providers or disjoint interfaces, builtin/reserved VID/PID, unknown profile/provider, profile vendor/kind mismatch. native_atk rows (including disabled) are always rejected. Profile catalog and allowed match fields come from providers.profiles; only Razer additions in stage 2a. disabled supports the existing engine HID brand providers, never native/Bluetooth readers. Disabled targets override accepted entries and builtins. level defaults to C; source defaults to empty. Only the selected profile's battery reads are allowed; metadata cannot select another protocol. Signatures, key trust and rollback policy belong to the C# host.
